name: Backend for Frontend (BFF)
forces_resolved: Tailored API payloads optimized specifically for distinct client types (iOS, Android, Web, IoT)
Prevents over-fetching and battery drain on mobile clients over cellular networks
Frontend teams own and deploy their specific BFF service independently
forces_unresolved: Code duplication across different BFF instances (e.g. mobile BFF vs web BFF)
Increased number of running services to manage and monitor
Additional network hop before reaching core domain services
applicability_conditions: Applications with multiple distinct client interfaces having drastically different UX requirements
High-traffic mobile apps requiring aggressive data aggregation and minimal roundtrips
Separate dedicated frontend teams operating on distinct release cadences
anti_requisites: Applications with only a single web frontend
Small engineering team with a single full-stack developer
Internal B2B APIs without customer-facing user interfaces
